selected.title: Asic strengthens AI safeguards
selected.summary: ASIC is strengthening safeguards for automated and AI-enabled trading while streamlining regulatory requirements for securities and futures market participants under incoming changes to its Market Integrity Rules (MIRs).
selected.why: ASIC is updating Market Integrity Rules to strengthen safeguards for AI-enabled trading.

reason: ASIC's AI trading safeguards assume regulators can define and enforce algorithmic risk ex-ante, but markets prove harm emerges unpredictably from novel system interactions.
angle: Prescriptive AI rules will lag real risks because algorithmic complexity evolves faster than regulatory frameworks can adapt.
